if.test: startdt != null and startdt != '' and enddt != null and enddt != ''

where.if: AND START_DT BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startdt} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(#{enddt} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

mapper.sql: SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, USE_YN, START_DT FROM NOTICE
mapper.delete: /* NoticeMapper.delete */ DELETE FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
